name: Jurien
shortDescription: The French cruiser line's starter ship: the heaviest guns and thickest armor of any tier I cruiser, held back by rough accuracy and a slow reload.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 5s action, 60s cooldown, unlimited charges. Same stock reset every tier I cruiser starts with, nothing unique to this hull.

turrets.note: Casemate mount, fixed to this broadside only.

strengths: 165mm main battery is the heaviest-caliber armament of any tier I cruiser, hitting for real per-shell damage instead of chipping away
Citadel is heavily armored on top and along the sides and sits below the waterline, backed by 6-160mm of plating that's hard to core even up close
14,100 hull HP gives her a deep pool to soak damage, near the top of what tier I cruisers carry
weaknesses: 23-knot top speed and 8.8 km sea detectability are a bad combination, she gets spotted easily and has no speed to break contact or reposition once she is
Dispersion is rough enough that shells frequently over- or under-shoot, so the big 165mm guns don't land as often as the caliber alone suggests
9s reload and an 18s 180-degree turret traverse mean that extra caliber comes out in a slow trickle, Legends' own player notes rate her actual output below Chikuma's smaller-caliber battery
5.8s rudder shift is sluggish, she won't snap into a dodge once she's committed to a heading
tips: Pick your engagements, don't count on outrunning a bad one at 23 knots
Lean on the armor, angle in and let 6-160mm of plating shrug off small stuff while the big guns work
Don't expect every salvo to land, the dispersion is rough enough that you'll eat some embarrassing overs and unders even on a lined-up shot
Commit to a heading early since the rudder is slow to answer, don't try to jink late into a turn

threats.reason: 23 knots isn't enough to dictate range or run from a fight someone else picked the terms for.

threats.threat: Anything already inside her gun range
threats.reason: Slow reload and rough dispersion mean she can't punish a close-range brawl as fast as the caliber promises.

summary: Big guns and heavy armor built around soaking hits and landing occasional heavy blows, not outreloading or out-turning anyone
Middling speed for the tier, not fast enough to dictate range, not slow enough to be pinned down
Dispersion undercuts the big-caliber advantage more than the raw numbers suggest
playstyle.detail: Jurien carries the heaviest guns of any tier I cruiser, 165mm rifles that hit harder per shell than anything else this early, wrapped in a hull with real armor and a deep hit point pool. The catch is getting those shells to land. Reload and turret traverse both run a touch slow, and dispersion is bad enough that a clean broadside can still miss more than it should. She isn't built to dictate a fight the way Chikuma does with speed, so pick an angle where the armor does its job and let the caliber advantage show up over the course of a fight instead of chasing one big alpha strike.

goalTags.note: Heaviest armor and citadel protection of any tier I cruiser, plus a top-of-tier HP pool, built to sit in close and soak hits.
